mapper.select: SELECT id, name, subtitle, description, main_img, price, origin_price, tag, sales_text, shop_name, shipping_from, service, type, is_featured, is_carousel, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM products WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, name, subtitle, description, main_img, price, origin_price, tag, sales_text, shop_name, shipping_from, service, type, is_featured, is_carousel, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM products
AND is_featured = 1
AND is_carousel = 1
ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id DESC
